policy_title: Increase police presence and efficiency on the beat
stated: Reform UK will ensure police return to the beat, utilise better technology, reduce paperwork, and allow PCSOs to become police officers before phasing out the role.

source.quote: More Bobbies on the Beat Ensure that police return to the beat and use better technology and stop wasting time on paperwork. Allow PCSOs to become police officers before the role is phased out.

bearing_set.reason: Directly targets policing capacity, street presence, and operational efficiency — all core indicators of street safety and justice system effectiveness.

membership_note: Single-target policy focused on policing effectiveness. 'Better technology' is too under-specified to pin to a concrete O10 surveillance mechanism (no mention of facial recognition, new stop-and-search powers, or surveillance mandates). The PCSO-to-officer transition has a minor fiscal implication (officers cost more than PCSOs) but is too small in scale relative to total police budgets to clear the non-negligible bar for O12. No other fundamental is materially touched.
